title: Advisory
description: Derived advisory record generated from a measurement + herd context. A local version is stored on-device. Server may recompute an authoritative version after sync. Both versions are kept.

is_server_authoritative.description: True = computed by cloud with full model context. False = computed on-device from local rule engine.

actions.description: Ordered list of actions the farmer should take, highest priority first.

action_key.description: Machine-readable key resolved to locale string in the UI.

action_params.description: Interpolation parameters for the action string template.

lab_name.description: Nearest NABL lab name. Only set for LAB_REFERRAL category.

ration_correction.description: Specific ration adjustment for this herd + this feed result. Null if no herd profile set.

herd_impacts.description: Body system impacts for the S5 Herd Impact 3D scene. Each entry maps to a highlighted region on the cow model.

explanation_key.description: Template key for tap-to-explain text and TTS.

fix_key.description: Template key for the specific fix action.

value_for_money_summary_key.description: e.g. 'overpriced_protein'. Resolved to locale string with params.

text.description: Pre-rendered advisory text keyed by Language enum key. All 8 languages populated before the record is stored.

tts_ids.description: UUIDv7s of pre-generated TTS audio files, keyed by language. Bundled offline.
